import sys

def main():
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    players = {}
    
    for _ in range(n):
        name, score = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
        score = int(score)
        
        if name not in players:
            players[name] = 0
        
        players[name] += score
    
    max_score = max(players.values())
    winner = None
    
    for _ in range(n):
        name, score = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
        score = int(score)
        
        if name not  in players:
            players[name] = 0
        
        players[name] += score
        
        if players[name] >= max_score:
            winner = name
            break
    
    print(winner)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
